title: Can Global XAI Methods Reveal Injected Bias in LLMs? SHAP vs Rule Extraction vs RuleSHAP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment and subjectivity of LLM-generated explanations across varying topics using NLP proxy metrics, LLM-as-a-judge ratings, and XAI rule-extraction algorithms to recover injected heuristic behaviors.

Measuring text length (character count) and readability (Gunning fog index) alongside LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, and using global XAI methods to detect injected rules that trigger excessively detailed or complex outputs.

Assessing outputs for superficial explanations of complex topics by analyzing shortened explanation lengths, low readability scores, LLM-as-a-judge direct evaluations, and using XAI rule-extraction methods.
